targets.query: from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="leaf" and r._field=="soc" and r.device=="$device") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
